source.failure_shape: A valid Phase-1 theorem ended in := sorry but its result type contained an earlier unparenthesized let or letI assignment. The ingestion boundary truncated the declaration at that inner assignment.

cases.label: lem:outer-let-contract
cases.declaration:
theorem lem_outer_let_contract (n : Nat) :
    let doubled : Nat := n + n
    doubled = n + n := sorry
cases.expected_header:
theorem lem_outer_let_contract (n : Nat) :
    let doubled : Nat := n + n
    doubled = n + n

cases.label: lem:outer-let-instance-contract
cases.declaration:
theorem lem_outer_let_instance_contract
    (R : Type) [Fintype R] :
    letI : DecidableEq R := Classical.decEq R
    forall x : R, x = x := sorry
cases.expected_header:
theorem lem_outer_let_instance_contract
    (R : Type) [Fintype R] :
    letI : DecidableEq R := Classical.decEq R
    forall x : R, x = x
